subject: The secret feature I almost didn't build
preview_text: This changes how you'll plan dates forever. You're the first to know what's coming next.
body_paragraphs: Okay, confession time. I was about to scrap a new feature because I thought it was too ambitious. Then I realized something: the couples who use SoulPlan the most are the ones who crave surprise the most. They're the ones who told me the routine was the real enemy.

So I kept building. And what's coming is the antidote to predictability. It's not just another list of ideas. It's a way to turn your shared history and inside jokes into fuel for your next adventure. Think of it as your relationship's personal memory lane, but with a twist that leads somewhere new.

You heard it here first: 'Memory Spark' is launching soon. It takes your past dates from your history and the dreams on your shared wishlist, then uses AI to design a completely new experience that feels deeply personal. It's like your relationship telling you what it wants to do next.

Want to make sure your date history is ready for it? Open the app and glance at your last few dates. The more SoulPlan knows, the better the spark. P.S. The first 50 users to try Memory Spark when it drops get a curated 'Anniversary Edition' date plan, on me.
